name: ShopCentral – Advanced Analytics for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
ShopCentral is a lightweight and powerful analytics plugin designed specifically for WooCommerce stores. Get instant insights into your store’s performance with clean, easy-to-understand metrics.

Key Features

  • Total Products Overview – See your complete product catalog at a glance
  • Sales Analytics – Track total sales revenue for any date range
  • Order Metrics – Monitor total orders and order trends
  • Sales/Order Ratio – Understand your average order value instantly
  • Top Selling Products – Identify your best performers quickly
  • Date Range Filtering – Analyze data for custom time periods
  • Lightweight & Fast – Minimal resource usage with smart caching
  • Clean Dashboard – Beautiful, intuitive interface built with WordPress standards

Why ShopCentral?

Unlike bloated analytics plugins that slow down your site, ShopCentral focuses on delivering essential metrics quickly and efficiently. Perfect for store owners who need actionable insights without the complexity.

Privacy & Data

ShopCentral respects your privacy:
* All data stays on your server
* No external API calls or data sharing
* No tracking or telemetry
* GDPR compliant

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/shopcentral/
* Documentation: https://dominopress.com/docs/shopcentral/

Credits

ShopCentral is developed and maintained by Dominopress.

Special thanks to the WordPress and WooCommerce communities for their excellent documentation and support.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ShopCentral”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  2. Navigate to ShopCentral in your WordPress admin menu
  3. View your store analytics instantly!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, ShopCentral is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and activated.

Will this slow down my website?

No! ShopCentral is designed to be lightweight with optimized database queries and smart caching. It only loads its resources on the analytics dashboard page.

Can I export the analytics data?

The current version focuses on dashboard viewing. Export functionality may be added in future updates based on user feedback.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce subscriptions and other extensions?

ShopCentral works with standard WooCommerce orders. Compatibility with specific extensions will be tested and documented in future releases.

How often is the data updated?

Data is cached for 1 hour for performance. You can manually refresh the data at any time using the “Refresh Data” button.

Can I customize the date range?

Yes! Use the date pickers at the top of the dashboard to select any custom date range for your analytics.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, ShopCentral is fully translation ready and uses the WordPress internationalization standards.
